description: You are returning to a project after 3 weeks away. Investigate the workspace state and create a summary document called WORK_CONTEXT.md in the workspace root directory (/home/ga/workspace/myproject/). The document must include these sections: 1) 'Modified Files' - list files with uncommitted changes and describe what was changed, 2) 'Outstanding TODOs' - search for TODO and FIXME comments across the workspace and list them with file locations, 3) 'Current Status' - identify what functionality is working vs broken, 4) 'Next Steps' - recommend what should be done next. Use git status/diff to see changes, use Ctrl+Shift+F to search for TODO/FIXME comments, and navigate through modified files to understand the context. The workspace is at /home/ga/workspace/myproject/ on branch feature/user-validation with uncommitted changes related to user validation functionality.
